faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HNBGU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to send the application via email for HNBGU Project Assistant recruitment is 15 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in HNBGU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant post in HNBGU recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for HNBGU Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for HNBGU Project Assistant posts is via Email. Candidates need to send their application to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Assistant post at HNBGU?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant post at HNBGU will receive a salary of Rs. 15000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Pharmaceutical Chemistry/ Chemistry or M.Pharm degree to be eligible for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for HNBGU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the HNBGU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for HNBGU Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process for HNBGU Project Assistant involves shortlisting of applications followed by a virtual interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for HNBGU Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Assistant post is Srinagar Garhwal, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q9. When was the HNBGU Project Assistant notification released?
faq.answer: The official notification for HNBGU Project Assistant recruitment was released on 30 July 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is the HNBGU Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The HNBGU Project Assistant position is a contractual job type.
